title: The configuration init takes
description: The argument of aprv.wasm's init export: the roots a chain must reach, each in padded standard base64: one DER certificate, or PEM text holding one or more certificates, which the core tells apart by the decoded bytes. {} (the one spelling a wrapper sends) or no bytes at all mean the three Apple roots compiled into the module. An empty roots list is refused ("roots must not be empty"), so a root set that came up empty fails at create instead of reading as the Apple roots; Verifier.create refuses a caller's empty root set before init all the same.

roots.description: DER certificates or PEM text, padded standard base64, in the order given.
